display_long_description:
Fudgerz is a fast‑paced, fan‑developed VR experience inspired by Gorilla Tag, built for players who love energetic movement, expressive interactions, and immersive social gameplay. The game focuses on smooth, physics‑based locomotion that lets you run, climb, vault, and explore using only your hands, creating a uniquely active and engaging style of play.

Every map and mechanic is crafted to encourage creativity and replayability, whether you’re mastering routes, racing friends, or discovering new ways to move through the environment. Fudgerz aims to capture the excitement and freedom of movement‑driven VR while adding its own charm, atmosphere, and community‑focused design.

The game is designed to be fun, accessible, and constantly evolving, offering players a lively world to explore and enjoy together. As a fan project, Fudgerz celebrates what makes movement‑based VR special while delivering a fresh, enjoyable experience for both new and returning players.

Created by @MrFudge‑YT — search the name on YouTube to follow updates, devlogs, and future content.
